interview.selfReported: Self-reported means you manually enter the count yourself rather than the app tracking it automatically.
interview.tomorrow: 8 - I like the straightforward daily challenge structure and the satisfying visual feedback of completing 10 pages, though I'd need to see if it keeps me consistent over the full 14 days.

goals.text: Open the challenge the app shows you, join it, log 12 pages and finish with Done. When the app asks, choose Keep it private.
